rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something independently or by oneself.

example.english: I want to complete this homework independently.
example.traditional: 我想自己完成呢份功課。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zi6 gei2 jyun4 sing4 ne1 fan6 gung1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress managing without anyone's help.

example.english: With no one to help, we have to solve the problem independently.
example.traditional: 冇人幫手，我哋都要靠自己解決問題。
example.jyutping: mou5 jan4 bong1 sau2 ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when separate people or groups do the same thing independently of one another.

example.english: After the show ended, they each went home independently.
example.traditional: 散場之後，大家各自返屋企。
example.jyutping: saan3 coeng4 zi1 hau6 daai6 gaa1 gok3 zi6 faan1 uk1 kei2
